methodology.docComments: Recovered from the comment above each registration in Dash-Web, not written here. A route with no comment is reported as having none
methodology.calls: Notable calls inside the handler, with the handler expanded through same-file helper definitions
methodology.effects: Database, filesystem, outbound network, subprocess, and external-model contact, classified from the expanded handler text
methodology.groupPurpose: Reviewed per family rather than per route: a family is one file with one job, which a reader can check
methodology.driftRule: Generation fails when a route family appears without a reviewed purpose, or a reviewed purpose outlives its family

groups.name: Adobe and video generation
groups.purpose: Drives Adobe Firefly and the video-generation pipeline, including cancelling work already in flight and polling what is still running.

groups.name: Assistant and ingestion
groups.purpose: Everything the assistant needs to turn outside material into Dash documents: capturing pages, chunking and formatting text, and creating the documents.

groups.name: Authentication and assets
groups.purpose: Signup, login, logout, and password reset, plus the script bundle and stylesheet the browser needs before any of that can run.

groups.name: Data and visualization
groups.purpose: Supplies tabular data to the visualization documents.

groups.name: Deletion utilities
groups.purpose: Destructive operator routes that drop database contents, uploaded files, or both. Admin-gated in a release build.

groups.name: Dynamic agent tools
groups.purpose: Stores and serves the agent tools that are defined at runtime rather than compiled into the client.

groups.name: Flashcard labeling
groups.purpose: Labels flashcard content for the study features.

groups.name: Google services
groups.purpose: Proxies Google Docs and Google Tasks so the credentials stay on the server rather than in the browser.

groups.name: Model services
groups.purpose: The general model endpoints: completion, embedding, image description, and the smaller model-backed helpers.

groups.name: Monitored-session operations
groups.purpose: Operator controls for a running server session, keyed by a session key rather than by a user: backup, debug output, and session teardown.

groups.name: Repository utilities
groups.purpose: Reports the running version and pulls the repository, which is how a deployment is updated in place.

groups.name: Shell and diagnostics
groups.purpose: Serves the application shell itself and the operator-facing pages around it: the root document, the admin surface, and per-document entry points.

groups.name: Uploads and media
groups.purpose: Accepts files into the server, inspects and transcodes media, and answers whether the server is reachable.

groups.name: User and activity
groups.purpose: Reads about the current user and the workspace state attached to them, including the identifiers a client needs before it can resolve sharing and links.

groups.name: Video stitching
groups.purpose: Submits, tracks, and health-checks the video stitching jobs that run outside the request that started them.
